arguments.summary: Investigated the issue and found that the pgbouncer connection pool in the prod namespace was exhausted, leading to connection failures and a backlog of 1388 jobs. Exported the failed_jobs table for the postmortem. Will need to coordinate with P17 to restart pgbouncer in prod.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Coordinate with P17 to restart pgbouncer in the prod namespace to clear the connection pool and resume job processing. Also, review the root cause of the connection pool exhaustion to prevent future occurrences.
